title: CLI Grid project
description: Declares which CLI agents belong to this folder. Lives at .vscode/cli-grid.json.

layout.description: Editor split restored when the folder is opened. "auto" picks the smallest split that fits the agents.

folder.description: Folder the CLI runs in, relative to this project. "." is the project root.

cli.description: Profile id, e.g. "claude", "codex", "gemini", or one you defined under cliGrid.profiles.

name.description: Shown in the Agents view instead of the folder name.

pinned.description: Whether starting the whole project starts this agent. Set to false to leave it out; it stays in the list and can still be started on its own.
